sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
sections.body: This Identification and Authentication Policy establishes requirements for identifying and authenticating users, processes, and devices accessing {system_name} operated by {org_name}. It applies across the system boundary described as {boundary} and protects Controlled Unclassified Information including {cui_description}.

sections.heading: 2. User Identification and Authentication

questions.prompt: How are system users uniquely identified?
How are system users authenticated before access is granted?

sections.body: System users are uniquely identified using {user_id_method}. User identity verification and authentication prior to system access is performed using {user_auth_method}.

sections.heading: 3. Process Identification and Authentication

questions.prompt: How are processes acting on behalf of users identified?
How are processes acting on behalf of users authenticated?

sections.body: Processes acting on behalf of users are identified using {process_id_method}. Authentication of processes acting on behalf of users before system access is executed through {process_auth_method}.

sections.heading: 4. Device Identification and Authentication

questions.prompt: How are devices accessing the system identified?
How are devices authenticated before connecting to the system?

sections.body: Devices accessing or connecting to the system are identified through {device_id_method}. Device identity is authenticated or verified prior to system connection using {device_auth_method}.
